newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Vinvestments to raise A$9 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Vinvestments to raise A$9 mln.

text.p: Vinvestments Ltd said on Wednesday it would raise A$9 million through a public offer of six million ordinary shares at a price of A$1.50 per share.

Previously known as A.I. Vincent Industries Ltd, the company sold its manufacturing activities and is about to enter into the biopharmaceutical industry with the new funds to be used to finance the change in direction.
Vinvestments said it would enter into contracts with four medical research institutes with certain projects to funded by Vinvestments.
The aim of the projects was to select and develop products that could be used for the diagnosis and treatment of inflammatory and auto-immune diseases.
The public offer is dependent on shareholder approval.
